description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于批量为DDoS高防实例绑定标签。

### QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call the CreateTagResources operation to add tags to multiple Anti-DDoS Proxy instances at a time.

### [](#qps-)Limits

You can call this operation up to 10 times per second per account. If the number of the calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo create-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --resource-type INSTANCE --resource-ids ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --tags Value=testvalue Key=testkey --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ddoscoo CreateTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --Tags.1.Value testvalue --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfm2pz25js0000' --ResourceIds.1 'ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000' --Tags.1.Key testkey --ResourceType INSTANCE --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
